title: Site Settings
description: Public brand/contact/newsletter/chat copy; one record named Storefront with slug storefront.

title: Services
description: One published record per service or package.

title: Assets
description: Domains now; website listings supported for later migration.

title: FAQs
description: Question in title, answer in content.

title: Content Blocks
description: Reusable trust statements, benefits, story cards and approved statistics.

title: Navigation Links
description: Public header/footer links and dropdown sources.

title: Longlife Digital | Page content

fields.name: lld_page_key
fields.label: Storefront page
fields.instructions: Set this for each storefront content page. Leave empty on WooCommerce Cart, Checkout, My Account and other unrelated pages. Create one published entry per key using the route table.

fields.name: lld_eyebrow
fields.label: Small heading / badge
fields.instructions: Optional text above the page heading; Home uses this as the hero badge.

fields.name: lld_heading
fields.label: Display heading
fields.instructions: Optional override of the WordPress page title. Home uses its three hero segments when supplied.

fields.name: lld_intro
fields.label: Page introduction
fields.instructions: Home uses this as the hero paragraph; other pages use it below the heading.

sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.instructions: Leave both label and destination empty to hide this button.

sub_fields.name: destination
sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.instructions: A storefront path such as /contact, or a complete HTTPS URL. Never a WordPress page permalink.

sub_fields.name: hero_prefix
sub_fields.label: Hero opening line
sub_fields.instructions: For example: Beautifully Crafted.

sub_fields.name: hero_highlight
sub_fields.label: Hero highlighted words
sub_fields.instructions: For example: Digital Products. Gradient styling remains in React.

sub_fields.name: hero_suffix
sub_fields.label: Hero closing line
sub_fields.instructions: For example: for Life & Business.

sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.instructions: Leave both label and destination empty to hide this button.

sub_fields.name: destination
sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.instructions: A storefront path such as /contact, or a complete HTTPS URL. Never a WordPress page permalink.

sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.instructions: Leave both label and destination empty to hide this button.

sub_fields.name: destination
sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.instructions: A storefront path such as /contact, or a complete HTTPS URL. Never a WordPress page permalink.

sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.instructions: Leave both label and destination empty to hide this button.

sub_fields.name: destination
sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.instructions: A storefront path such as /contact, or a complete HTTPS URL. Never a WordPress page permalink.

sub_fields.name: trust_items
sub_fields.label: Trust strip items
sub_fields.instructions: Select blocks of kind Trust statement; approve delivery/payment claims before publishing.

sub_fields.name: hero_stats
sub_fields.label: Additional hero statistics
sub_fields.instructions: Select approved Statistic blocks. Product count and product review averages are derived from WooCommerce, not manually entered here.

sub_fields.name: benefits
sub_fields.label: Benefits
sub_fields.instructions: Select Benefit blocks in display order.

sub_fields.name: stats
sub_fields.label: Statistics
sub_fields.instructions: Select verified Statistic blocks. Hide unverified claims.

sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.instructions: Leave both label and destination empty to hide this button.

sub_fields.name: destination
sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.instructions: A storefront path such as /contact, or a complete HTTPS URL. Never a WordPress page permalink.

sub_fields.name: posts
sub_fields.label: Featured articles
sub_fields.instructions: Choose up to three published posts. Empty means the latest three published posts.

sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.instructions: Leave both label and destination empty to hide this button.

sub_fields.name: destination
sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.instructions: A storefront path such as /contact, or a complete HTTPS URL. Never a WordPress page permalink.

sub_fields.name: sections
sub_fields.label: Mission, offering and promise cards
sub_fields.instructions: Select Value/story blocks. Native page content can hold additional introductory prose.

sub_fields.name: success_body
sub_fields.label: Success message
sub_fields.instructions: Show only after the future submission API confirms receipt, not on a failed request.

sub_fields.name: updated_on
sub_fields.label: Policy effective / updated date
sub_fields.instructions: Date of the approved policy text, not the last incidental WordPress edit.

description: Shared page headings and structured sections. Policy prose lives in the native WordPress editor. Collection cards remain separate records. No CSS or React layout code is stored in these fields.

title: Longlife Digital | Site settings

sub_fields.name: logo
sub_fields.label: Brand logo
sub_fields.instructions: Public presentation media only. Purchased files and signed download links do not belong here.

sub_fields.name: attachment
sub_fields.label: WordPress image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional public preview image; REST value is an attachment ID.

sub_fields.name: public_url
sub_fields.label: Public image URL
sub_fields.instructions: Optional HTTPS public image, including a public Firebase preview. If set, this takes precedence over the attachment.

sub_fields.name: alt
sub_fields.label: Alternative text
sub_fields.instructions: Describe meaningful images; empty for purely decorative images.

sub_fields.name: email
sub_fields.label: Support email
sub_fields.instructions: Resolve the existing support@lldhome.com versus support@longlifedigital.co mismatch before publishing.

sub_fields.name: message
sub_fields.label: Message
sub_fields.instructions: Public marketing copy. Any advertised offer must match an active WooCommerce coupon.

sub_fields.name: coupon_code
sub_fields.label: Displayed coupon code
sub_fields.instructions: Display only; does not create, enable or validate a coupon.

sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.instructions: Leave both label and destination empty to hide this button.

sub_fields.name: destination
sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.instructions: A storefront path such as /contact, or a complete HTTPS URL. Never a WordPress page permalink.

sub_fields.name: copyright_name
sub_fields.label: Copyright owner
sub_fields.instructions: Year is generated by React; do not enter a fixed year.

sub_fields.name: enabled
sub_fields.label: Show newsletter signup
sub_fields.instructions: Enable in the integrated storefront only once subscription persistence is available.

sub_fields.name: suggested_questions
sub_fields.label: Suggested questions
sub_fields.instructions: One question per line; front end caps the list at four. Public copy only, never model instructions or credentials.

description: One published record with slug storefront. This is a public content record, not an ACF Pro Options Page. Do not put secrets, staff notes or customer records here.

title: Longlife Digital | Service details

fields.name: lld_icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.instructions: A short emoji or symbol; no HTML or SVG.

fields.name: lld_nav_label
fields.label: Short menu label
fields.instructions: Optional; fallback is the service title.

fields.name: lld_pricing_mode
fields.label: Pricing display
fields.instructions: A quoted amount is informational only. Purchasable prices always come from the linked WooCommerce product.

fields.name: lld_amount
fields.label: Indicative amount
fields.instructions: Never used to charge a customer.

fields.name: lld_currency
fields.label: Quote currency
fields.instructions: Initial business currency; expand deliberately if other currencies are supported.

fields.name: lld_billing_period
fields.label: Price wording
fields.instructions: Display wording only; this does not create a subscription.

fields.name: lld_product
fields.label: Linked WooCommerce product
fields.instructions: Choose a published product. Resolve its ID through the WooCommerce catalog. Checkout remains a later integration.

sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.instructions: Leave both label and destination empty to hide this button.

sub_fields.name: destination
sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.instructions: A storefront path such as /contact, or a complete HTTPS URL. Never a WordPress page permalink.

description: Native title is the service name, excerpt is the card description, content is extended copy, featured image is optional and menu_order controls sorting. The same records feed the Services menu and contact form service choices.

fields.name: lld_demo_url

sub_fields.name: destination

title: Longlife Digital | FAQ placement

fields.name: lld_topics
fields.label: Relevant sections
fields.instructions: General items appear on the FAQ page. Additional placements can be connected later.

description: Native title is the question and native content is the formatted answer. Use menu_order for ordering. Store approved explanations, not application rules or customer messages.

title: Longlife Digital | Reusable content block

fields.name: lld_icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.instructions: Optional short emoji or symbol.

fields.name: lld_stat_value
fields.label: Statistic display value
fields.instructions: Only approved, supportable marketing figures. Do not duplicate live product counts, prices or product ratings.

description: Native title is the label, excerpt the short description, and content longer story-card text. Homepage/About relationship fields select and order blocks; no ACF Pro Repeater is required.

title: Longlife Digital | Navigation link

fields.name: lld_destination
fields.label: Destination
fields.instructions: Storefront path, approved HTTPS URL, mailto: or tel:. Never javascript:, a CMS admin URL or a file download token.

fields.name: lld_new_tab
fields.label: Open external link in new tab

fields.name: lld_parent
fields.label: Parent navigation record
fields.instructions: Optional. Choose a top-level record in the same menu area with Manual children. One level only; no cycles.

description: Native title is the label, excerpt is an optional dropdown description, and menu_order controls sibling order. Service/category dropdowns are derived from their records so their names are not copied into multiple lists.

title: Longlife Digital | Product display extras

fields.name: lld_includes
fields.label: What is included
fields.instructions: Optional additional product section; do not repeat the full WooCommerce description.

fields.name: lld_level
fields.label: Audience / skill level
fields.instructions: For example: Beginner or All levels. Optional.

fields.name: lld_duration
fields.label: Course duration
fields.instructions: Display text only, for example 10 weeks. No enrollment or entitlement logic.

fields.name: lld_license_summary
fields.label: Public license summary
fields.instructions: Plain-language display copy; any licensed deliverable is handled separately.

description: Optional product metadata only. WooCommerce owns title, description, short description, categories, images, tags, featured status, prices, discounts, ratings, stock and purchasing rules. ACF REST visibility does not automatically add these extras to the WooCommerce Store API.

title: Longlife Digital | Search and sharing metadata

fields.name: lld_seo_title
fields.label: Search title
fields.instructions: Optional; fallback is the page or product title plus brand.

fields.name: lld_meta_description
fields.label: Search description
fields.instructions: Optional concise summary; not a ranking guarantee.

fields.name: lld_share_image
fields.label: Social sharing image
fields.instructions: Public presentation media only. Purchased files and signed download links do not belong here.

sub_fields.name: attachment
sub_fields.label: WordPress image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional public preview image; REST value is an attachment ID.

sub_fields.name: public_url
sub_fields.label: Public image URL
sub_fields.instructions: Optional HTTPS public image, including a public Firebase preview. If set, this takes precedence over the attachment.

sub_fields.name: alt
sub_fields.label: Alternative text
sub_fields.instructions: Describe meaningful images; empty for purely decorative images.

fields.name: lld_noindex
fields.label: Request noindex
fields.instructions: An indexing preference only, not access control. The React metadata/prerender integration must apply it.

description: Applies to public pages, posts, services, assets and products. Use this as the initial metadata source; reconcile with any future SEO plugin instead of maintaining two competing sets of fields.

title: Longlife Digital | Asset category display

fields.name: lld_icon
fields.label: Category icon
fields.instructions: Optional short emoji or symbol.

description: Native term name and description supply category labels and menu descriptions. Native slug identifies each filter. Initial categories: Premium, Brandable, Local, AI-related, Marketing and Real Estate.
